description: AZURE DEVOPS ONLY -- List all wikis in a project (the project wiki plus any published code-as-wiki repos). Use this FIRST when the user doesn't know the wiki's exact name/id, or to confirm which wiki to target before reading/writing a page. Requires DEVOPS_ORG_URL + DEVOPS_PAT env vars.

project.description: Optional: Azure DevOps project name. Falls back to DEVOPS_PROJECT env var.

name: ado_wiki_list
